p: A person should always pray that he will not become ill,
as if he becomes ill they say to him:
Mimenu, from him proof must be brought.
The school of Rabbi Yishmael taught:
If the fallen falls from it? … This … was destined to fall
If the fallen falls from it? This person was destined to fall
from the six days of Creation,
the verse calls him fallen. … Nevertheless,
the verse calls him fallen. Nevertheless,
merit is engendered by means of … innocent and guilt by means of … guilty.
merit is engendered by means of the innocent and guilt by means of the guilty.
